name: Caesarea Philippi
overview: Caesarea Philippi was a city in the northern region of Palestine where Jesus engaged his disciples with a profound question about His identity. As recorded in Matthew 16:13, Mark 8:27, and Luke 9:18, Jesus asked His followers whom people said He was, prompting reflection on His divine nature as the Son of Man. This moment highlights the importance of recognizing Christ’s true identity, a foundational truth for faith and discipleship.
